Messages.Author: DJ.Mik
Messages.Body:
Is an anarch vampire with Firebrand a titled vampire ?

Text on the card says that this vampire gains 1 vote during Political
Actions, does this mean that it's not considered titled, but only has
1 vote for voting purposes ?

This came up yesterday when we played and a Free States Rant was
played. Does a firebranded vampire lose its vote during the free
states rant ?

Thanx for the quick answers !!
Greets DJ Mik

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
DJ.Mik wrote:
> Is an anarch vampire with Firebrand a titled vampire ?

No.

> Text on the card says that this vampire gains 1 vote during Political
> Actions, does this mean that it's not considered titled, but only has
> 1 vote for voting purposes ?

It doesn't affect whether the vampire is considered titled.
A titled vampire with a Firebrand is titled.
An untitled vampire with a Firebrand is not titled.

> This came up yesterday when we played and a Free States Rant was
> played. Does a firebranded vampire lose its vote during the free
> states rant ?

No.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 11 Aug 2003 09:05:18 -0700, djmi...@hotmail.com (DJ.Mik) wrote:

>Is an anarch vampire with Firebrand a titled vampire ?

This is explicitly covered in the FAQ, section 3.35.

http://www.thelasombra.com/vtes_faq.htm

>Text on the card says that this vampire gains 1 vote during Political
>Actions, does this mean that it's not considered titled, but only has
>1 vote for voting purposes ?

Correct.

>This came up yesterday when we played and a Free States Rant was
>played. Does a firebranded vampire lose its vote during the free
>states rant ?

No.

3.35 Which vampires are titled?
Which vampires have fewer votes in a Free States Rant vote?

Sabbat titles:
Bishop
Archbishop
Priscus
Cardinal

Camarilla titles:
Primogen
Prince
Justicar
Inner Circle

Independent titles:
1 vote
2 votes

Anarch titles:
Baron

These are only for cards that come into play with their titles.
Any other card that grants votes must explicitly state that it
is granting a title for the votes to count as a title.

Is a vampire "titled" if he has votes from Legendary Vampire,
Bloodbath, Legacy of Pander, Political Struggle, or Firebrand?

Not unless they have (or gain) one of the titles listed above.

Also see section 10 of the rulebook:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/
